purpose: Known failures captured before the owner-requested world reset. Evaluation cases, not name-based production exceptions.

cases.name: Named vehicle versus generic monster mentions
passages: And no, it's a semi. We call her 'Beast.' And there were another twelve cars behind her.
Behind me lay Beast, Whiskey's semi, once loaded down with goods, it was now our makeshift home and fortification.
Alec and Ragger split apart, flanking the beast from either side.
cases.expected: Resolve the named vehicle Beast separately from generic beast references. Do not merge monster/form evidence into the vehicle dossier or classify the semi as a place.

cases.name: Incidental object is not a setting dossier
passages: I stared into the toilet, watching the liquid swirl around the edges and sighed.
cases.expected: This incidental object alone does not justify a standalone place dossier.

cases.name: Established settlement remains reachable
passages: I spun on my heel and marched towards the crumbling ruins of the once-thriving Sanctuary, Kondura shuffling at my heels.
cases.expected: Sanctuary remains a distinct place. The saved reset-time record was active, but the owner could not find it in the UI; verify both classification and rendering/pagination. Preserve temporal ruin state rather than rewriting all earlier history.
